items.name: generate_image
items.description: Create an image generation task (text-to-image, or image-to-image when image_urls are provided). Pro/Ultra flagship models (GPT Image 2, GPT Image 2.5, Nano Banana 2, Grok Imagine) and Ultra ViewMax C1 cost 0 credits within the shared daily fair-use pool; otherwise this consumes credits. Call wait_for_task with the task_id for the result URLs.

input.name: idempotency_key
input.description: Optional, 1-200 visible ASCII characters without spaces. Reuse the same key when retrying after a timeout; a repeated key returns the original task and is not charged again.

items.name: generate_music
items.description: Create an original music track from a text prompt. Costs 60 credits for tracks up to 60 seconds, then 1 credit per second (duration_seconds defaults to 60); plan allowances do not cover music. Setting style sends prompt as the song's lyrics, so do not also send lyrics; to describe a track, put the description in prompt and omit style. Music renders synchronously: the result usually returns immediately with output_urls.

input.name: idempotency_key
input.description: Optional, 1-200 visible ASCII characters without spaces. Reuse the same key when retrying after a timeout; a repeated key returns the original task and is not charged again.

items.name: generate_sound_effect
items.description: Generate a sound effect from a text prompt of at most 450 Unicode characters. Costs 5 credits. Renders synchronously: the result usually returns immediately with output_urls.

input.name: idempotency_key
input.description: Optional, 1-200 visible ASCII characters without spaces. Reuse the same key when retrying after a timeout; a repeated key returns the original task and is not charged again.

input.name: prompt
input.description: Sound effect description, at most 450 Unicode characters.

items.name: generate_speech
items.description: Convert text to speech with a selected voice_id (see list_voices). Costs ceil(characters / 20) credits, minimum 1. Speech renders synchronously: the result usually returns immediately with output_urls.

input.name: idempotency_key
input.description: Optional, 1-200 visible ASCII characters without spaces. Reuse the same key when retrying after a timeout; a repeated key returns the original task and is not charged again.

items.name: generate_video
items.description: Create a video generation task and return its task_id. mode defaults to image-to-video when image_urls are given, else video-to-video when video_urls are given, else text-to-video. Omitted duration, resolution and aspect_ratio use the mode's defaults from get_video_model and are billed at those values. Ultra ViewMax C1 generations cost 0 credits within the daily fair-use pool (also via REST API); otherwise this consumes credits from the authenticated ViewMax account. Call wait_for_task with the task_id until it finishes.

input.name: idempotency_key
input.description: Optional, 1-200 visible ASCII characters without spaces. Reuse the same key when retrying after a timeout; a repeated key returns the original task and is not charged again.

items.name: get_credits
items.description: Get the authenticated account's remaining credits. Generation consumes credits.

items.name: get_image_model
items.description: Get full capabilities and credit pricing for one image model. Generating an image with this model consumes credits.

items.name: get_task
items.description: Get the current status, output URLs and cost_credits for one of the authenticated user's tasks (video, image, music, or audio). Failed and canceled tasks include error_code and error_message; their credits are refunded automatically.

items.name: get_video_model
items.description: Get full capabilities and credit pricing for one video model. Each mode lists durations, resolutions, aspect_ratios, audio_toggle, credits, and defaults: the duration, resolution and aspect_ratio that generate_video sends and bills when you omit them. max_prompt_length is present when the model limits prompt length. Generating a video with this model consumes credits.

items.name: list_image_models
items.description: List available image models with their modes (text-to-image, image-to-image), aspect ratios, qualities, and credit labels. Image generation consumes credits.

items.name: list_music_models
items.description: List available music models and their controls (duration, instrumental) and credit cost. Music costs 60 credits for tracks up to 60 seconds, then 1 credit per second.

items.name: list_video_models
items.description: List available video models and their capabilities. Video generation consumes credits; use get_video_model for detailed pricing and the values used when options are omitted.

items.name: list_voices
items.description: List available text-to-speech voices (id, name, gender, accent, language) and speech pricing: characters_per_credit and minimum_credits. A generation costs ceil(characters / 20) credits, minimum 1.

items.name: wait_for_task
items.description: Wait up to timeout_seconds (1-50, default 45) for a task and return its latest status in the get_task shape. Some videos take several minutes: keep calling wait_for_task until status is success, failed, or canceled. Task results are persisted and never lost.

items.name: create_bug_report
items.description: Generate a link to the Vuetify issues site with the repository and bug report type pre-selected.

input.name: label
input.description: Optional label to pre-fill on the bug report.

input.name: repo
input.description: The repository to report a bug against. Available: vuetify, vuetify/docs, vuetify0, mcp, play, bin, studio, snips, link, issues

items.name: get_component_api_by_version

input.name: componentName
input.description: The name of a Vuetify component, available options here: [REDACTED URI]

input.name: version
input.description: The version of Vuetify to retrieve API types for, e.g., "latest" or "3.0.0"

items.name: get_directive_api_by_version
items.description: Return the API information for a Vuetify directive

input.name: directiveName
input.description: The name of a Vuetify directive, e.g., "v-ripple" or "ripple"

input.name: version
input.description: The version of Vuetify to retrieve API types for, e.g., "latest" or "3.0.0"

items.name: get_exposed_exports
items.description: Get a list of exports from the Vuetify npm package

items.name: get_feature_guide
items.description: Get the information about a specific feature in the documentation.

input.name: feature
input.description: The feature for which to get the documentation. Available features: accessibility, aliasing, application-layout, blueprints, dates, display-and-platform, global-configuration, icon-fonts, internationalization, programmatic-scrolling, sass-variables, theme

items.name: get_feature_guides
items.description: Get a list of available features in the documentation.

items.name: get_frequently_asked_questions
items.description: Get a list of frequently asked questions about Vuetify.

items.name: get_installation_guide
items.description: Get detailed information about how to install Vuetify in a variety of environments.

input.name: fresh
input.description: Whether the user has an existing project or is starting fresh.

input.name: platform
input.description: The platform for which to get the installation guide. Available platforms: vite, nuxt, nuxt-module, laravel, cdn, cdn-esm, vitepress, vuetify0

Only the round trip is evidence: PTR names a host, that host resolves back to the same address. That pair is forward-confirmed reverse DNS (FCrDNS), it is what Google and Yahoo mean when they list forward and reverse DNS among their bulk sender requirements, and it is what `fcrdns` reports. Over IPv6 it is stricter still: G
